title: Machine passport
description: Everything that sets one machine apart from another: architecture, files, hardware variants. It lives as the machine.yaml file in the machine chart and reaches the hook via the paleocomputing.io/machine annotation. The root is closed: the passport is not values, the Cozystack engine injects nothing here, and an extra field is almost always a typo.

image.description: Image that carries the machine files (ROM, disk). The emulator is not needed in it: it lives in the virt-launcher image.

arch.description: Architecture as libvirt knows it (os/type@arch). Must be compiled into the libvirt of the virt-launcher image.

emulator.description: Path to the emulator INSIDE the virt-launcher image.

vcpus.description: Number of machine CPUs. libvirt rejects more than the machine supports.

graphics.description: vnc: the screen is visible in the KubeVirt console and via virtctl vnc; none: a machine without a screen.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: How long KubeVirt waits for the machine to shut down by itself. A machine without ACPI has nobody to hear a shutdown request; 0 means "power off at once".

path.description: Where the volume with the files is mounted, both in the hook and in the libvirt container.

name.description: File name on the volume, without directories.

from.description: Path to the file inside image.

size.description: Minimum size of a disk file in bytes. The fill job extends a smaller disk with zeros, a new one and one already on the volume alike, and never shrinks it.

role.description: firmware: rewritten from the image on every install and update; disk: user data, placed only if the file is missing or empty.

qemu.description: Emulator arguments for this file; {path} is replaced with the full path on the volume.

variants.description: Hardware variants: name → -machine properties. An empty object means the machine as is.

variant.description: The selected variant. It is not in the chart passport: the library adds it to the annotation from the hardware value.

memory.description: Machine memory in KubeVirt: default and limits. Only Mi and Gi: the library compares them at render time.
